title: Progressive-Resolution Secure Aggregation for Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00695v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Secure aggregation lets a server recover an aggregate of client updates without observing any individual update, but conventional protocols fix the aggregate precision when clients upload. We introduce and formulate a new progressive-resolution secure-aggregation functionality in which clients upload once and successively finer resolutions of the same aggregate can later be authorized without renewed client participation. To realize this functionality, we propose progressive-resolution secure aggregation (PSA): each clipped, dithered update is represented by compatible nested-lattice digits; separately releasable layers are protected by secure aggregation and an additional aggregate pad that remains unavailable to the server until a non-colluding release controller authorizes that layer.

translated_title: 面向联邦学习的渐进分辨率安全聚合
translated_abstract: 安全聚合使服务器能够在不观察任何单个客户端更新的情况下恢复客户端更新的聚合结果，但传统协议在客户端上传时就固定了聚合的精度。我们引入并形式化了一种新的渐进分辨率安全聚合功能：客户端只需上传一次，之后无需客户端再次参与，即可授权释放同一聚合结果的逐步更精细的分辨率。为了实现这一功能，我们提出了渐进分辨率安全聚合（PSA）：每个经过裁剪和抖动处理的更新由兼容的嵌套格点数表示；可单独释放的各层由安全聚合和一个额外的聚合掩码加以保护，该掩码在不与服务器串通的释放控制器授权相应层之前，服务器始终无法获得。
tldr: 该论文提出渐进分辨率安全聚合（PSA），使客户端只需上传一次，服务器便可在授权后无需客户端再次参与的情况下逐步获得更精细分辨率的聚合更新。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes progressive-resolution secure aggregation (PSA), which allows clients to upload only once while the server can later be authorized to obtain successively finer resolutions of the aggregate without renewed client participation.
